commits.comment: 修复 DynamicCVPipeline 的 CloneOps 在多缓冲包裹下的同步擦除（#2161）。背景：CloneOps 为消除 cluster 内的跨 block memref 依赖，会把早期 block 的 op 克隆到后面的 block；Rule 1 按 op 类型匹配 SyncBlockWaitOp/SyncBlockSetOp/FixpipeOp 并擦除克隆体中的这些同步/传输 op。但 inter-core multi-buffering（>1 buffer）在上游已把每个 sync op 包裹在 scf.if 中（按迭代选择本半 buffer 对应的 flag），导致类型匹配失效，克隆的握手被保留下来，同一 tile 被两个不同迭代计数器以不同 parity 通知两次，出现静默错误或挂起（flash attention 在 128x128 出错、64x64 hang）。修复：(1) shouldEraseOpForCube 扩展匹配“无结果且内部仅含 sync 的 scf.if”；(2) validateClonedSyncOpsErased 增加 op.walk 检查嵌套 sync，作为安全网触发 fallback 而不再输出重复握手。新增 lit 测试 clone-wrapped-sync.mlir 验证恰好只保留原始一次通知。风险中等：类型匹配扩展到 scf.if 依赖“yield 空”这一约束，若未来多缓冲 wrapper 变化（比如包裹其它 op 或产生结果），需同步更新；validate 新增嵌套 walk 会在合法用例下引入少量编译开销。

test_impact.reason: 跨核多缓冲 + CloneOps 组合属于复杂控制流场景，典型的静默错误/挂起 bug，必须有针对性 lit 覆盖。新增 clone-wrapped-sync.mlir 覆盖了“consumer 读取同一 buffer 导致 clone 存活、只有类型匹配才能擦除”的关键路径，测试点选择合理。

commits.message:
[ssbuffer](fix) erase cloned sync ops wrapped by multi-buffering (#2161)

CloneOps replays an earlier block's operations into a later one to make each block self-contained, which is how a cross-block memref dependency in a CUBE scope gets resolved, and erases from the copy what belongs to the original block. Rule 1 of that cleanup matches synchronisation and transfer ops by operation type. Inter-core multi-buffering runs earlier and, above a buffer count of one, wraps every sync op in an scf.if selecting this iteration's buffer half, so the type test stops matching and a cloned handshake is kept by the dependency rules.

One produced tile is then announced twice, from two pipeline stages whose iteration counters are their own, so one flag pair runs on two unrelated parities: the consumer is released by a producer that has not finished writing, or by nobody. Observed on flash attention at an inter-core buffer count of 2 as wrong results at 128x128 and a hang at 64x64, both silent.

Erase the wrapped form as well, restricted to scf.ifs that yield nothing so the wrapper around a transfer op is untouched, and make validateClonedSyncOpsErased look inside cloned ops so a clone that still survives falls back instead of emitting a duplicated handshake.

Signed-off-by: CrDem <147323633+CrDem@users.noreply.github.com>
